hero.title: Complete the Quran together — one khatmah, many hearts
hero.lead: Split the 30 juz' across your family, friends or masjid, claim your part, and watch the whole Quran finish in real time. Free, instant, no signup.

steps.title: Done in three simple steps
steps.s1b: Pick how many people will join. We divide the Quran fairly for you.
steps.s2b: Send the room code or link. Everyone joins in one tap — no account needed.
steps.s3b: Claim your part, mark it done, and watch the khatmah complete live.

benefits.title: Why families & communities love it
benefits.sub: Everything you need to finish the Quran together — and nothing you don't.
benefits.b1b: Every started and completed part updates instantly for the whole group.
benefits.b2b: Fair shares along real juz' boundaries and the 604-page Madani mushaf.
benefits.b3b: Built mobile-first. Works on every phone, tablet and laptop — no install.
benefits.b4b: Full English and Bangla interface, with Uthmani and Indo-Pak scripts.
benefits.b5b: No accounts, no tracking. Just a room code shared with the people you choose.
benefits.b6b: Dedicate your khatmah to a loved one — a beautiful, ongoing sadaqah jariyah.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: A khatmah is completing the entire Quran. Here a group shares the work so the whole Quran is finished together.
faq.q2: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faq.a2: It's 100% free with no signup. Create a room, share the code, and begin — no email or password.
faq.a3: Along authentic juz' boundaries and the 604-page Madani mushaf, so every share is fair and accurate.
faq.q4: Can we join from different places?
faq.a4: Yes — anyone with the code can join from any device, and progress syncs live for everyone.
faq.q5: Which scripts and languages are supported?
faq.a5: Madani/Uthmani and Indo-Pak scripts, with a full English and Bangla (বাংলা) interface.
